slides.heading: Reception — Autumn 2, Week 3
slides.sub: New sounds taught directly, practised and applied in words, captions and the matching decodable book.

slides.heading: Mon
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "l" (/l/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="log" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="log"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Lila the leaf lets go of her branch and glides down long and smooth — 'llll'.

character.name: Lila
character.blurb: Lila is a slim, gently veined leaf who takes her time drifting all the way down from the highest branch.

slides.pronunciation_note: A clear, light sound with the tongue tip touching just behind the top teeth — 'l', not 'luh'.
slides.formation_cue: Start at the top of a tall line. Pull straight down. Finish on the line.
slides.formation_rhyme: One tall line, top to bottom.
slides.action: Raise one arm straight up, then lower it slowly and smoothly, like Lila drifting down, saying a long 'llll'.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="log" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="log"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.tip: Just like 'no', the o in 'go' says its long name 'oh' rather than the short sound from 'dog' — picture the two letters setting off on a journey.

slides.dictation: A dog has a bad leg.

slides.heading: Tue
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "ll" (/l/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="bell" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="bell"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Lottie and Lacey the ladybirds perch side by side on a tall blade of grass, both humming a long 'llll' together.

character.name: Lottie & Lacey
character.blurb: Lottie and Lacey are two spotty ladybirds who go everywhere together, always perching side by side.

slides.pronunciation_note: Two letters, one clear sound — 'll' says exactly the same as single 'l', often at the end of short words.
slides.formation_cue: Write 'l' twice, close together — two letters, one sound.
slides.action: Hold up two fingers side by side, like Lottie and Lacey together, and say one long 'llll'.
slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="bell" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="bell"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.heading: Wed
slides.objective: Learn the new sound "ss" (/s/) and start reading and spelling words that use it.

slides.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="320" height="320" role="img" aria-label="grass" class="wp-icon wp-raster" data-picture="grass"><image href="data:image/png;base64," x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>

slides.mnemonic: Silva and Sable the snails race side by side, each leaving a long hissing trail — 'ssss'.

character.name: Silva & Sable
character.blurb: Silva and Sable are two garden snails who love a slow race, always finishing exactly side by side.

slides.pronunciation_note: Two letters, one long hiss — 'ss' says exactly the same as single 's', often at the end of short words.
slides.formation_cue: Write 's' twice, close together — two letters, one sound.
slides.action: Trace two wavy trails in the air at once, one with each hand, while hissing a long 'ssss', like Silva and Sable racing.

slides.heading: Thu
slides.objective: Extra practice blending and segmenting everything taught this week — no new content today.

slides.heading: Fri
slides.objective: Revisit everything taught this week, read the matched decodable book, and check how securely it has been learned.
